final: WITH f AS (SELECT raceId, points, wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 AND points IS NOT NULL AND wins IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM f GROUP BY raceId), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall FROM r) SELECT r.raceId, r.avg_points, r.avg_wins, r.avg_wins - o.overall AS diff FROM r, o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r.avg_wins - o.overall) IS NULL, (r.avg_wins - o.overall) DESC LIMIT 10
